g.text: Step "retrieval" done, step "writing" active with the brief
Stream the article text, with the draft, the profile,
the passages and any selection to replace
Open the range after the cursor's block,
Tint the range and refuse the writer's own edits inside it
Insert each block once a blank line closes it,
data-article-done, with the words and the headings
Replace the range with its final content as ONE undo step,
Remove the range and restore the replaced blocks
The range always opens at a block boundary, never inside the writer's
paragraph, so every node the writer owns stays byte-identical and Discard
restores the document exactly. A selection is widened to whole blocks
before it is sent. Only after Keep can one Ctrl+Z undo the whole write.
